设 $z=\left(\frac{y+x}{\sqrt[y]{x^2+1}}\right)^{1/3}$，求 $z_x$。 $\frac{y(x^2+1)+2x(x+y)}{3(y+x)(x^2+1)}z$ $\frac{y(x^2+1)-2x(x+y)}{3(y+x)(x^2+1)}z$ $\frac{y(x^2+1)-2x(x+y)}{3(y+x)(x^2+1)y}z$ $\frac{y(x^2+1)-2x(x+y)}{6(y+x)(x^2+1)y}z$ 有题设可知：

$$
\ln|z|=\frac{1}{3}\left[\ln|y+x|-\frac{1}{y}\ln(x^2+1)\right]
$$

$$
\frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{3}\left[\frac{1}{y+x}-\frac{2x}{y(x^2+1)}\right]
$$

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{y(x^2+1)-2x(x+y)}{3(y+x)(x^2+1)y}\left(\frac{y+x}{\sqrt[y]{1+x^2}}\right)^{1/3}
$$
